ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  5paisa Capital Limited has received a Show Cause cum Demand Notice from CGST & C. Excise for a proposed recovery of Rs. 15.31 crore, plus interest and penalty, pertaining to alleged excess and ineligible Input Tax Credit for FY 2022-23. While the company disputes the notice, asserting it has no merits and anticipates no financial or operational impact, the significant amount represents a material potential liability and a red flag for investors to monitor.
